suggestions.description: The unselected tap-layout cards have disabled-looking foreground contrast instead of the normal black treatment shown by the reference.
suggestions.evidence: At approximately logical y=298-426, the L-shaped and swipe-only cards have light-gray labels, radio outlines, and diagrams. At the same logical positions, the reference uses black labels and strokes for both unselected cards. This case has no declared capability bound or intentional difference for these alternatives.
suggestions.recommendation: Render selectable unselected tap-layout cards with the reference's normal black foreground and diagram strokes. If either alternative is genuinely unavailable, explicitly document that capability bound and its unavailable state rather than leaving the contrast difference unexplained.

limitations: This independent review covers only the two assigned screenshot pairs and does not establish that the full round is clean.
All four original PNG files were actually viewed through tools.view_image. No application, build, test, smoke test, runtime probe, Git operation, or product modification was performed.

Static screenshots establish appearance only. They do not prove hit-target behavior, persistence, real authorization functionality, or physical-device behavior. In particular, disabled-looking tap-layout cards are a visual finding, not a claim that interaction was tested.

Coordinates and dimensions in visual observations are approximate logical estimates. Source PNG bytes were not resized, edited, or otherwise modified; the image viewer resized the physical reference for display.
